title: Burp Suite or Nikto: Deep Web App Testing vs Quick Server Scanning
excerpt: Burp Suite is an interactive toolkit for in-depth web application testing; Nikto is a fast, free command-line scanner for common web server issues. They suit different stages of a test.
verdict: Burp Suite is the tool for genuinely deep web application penetration testing. Nikto is a quick, free first pass that flags common misconfigurations and outdated software before you dig deeper with more powerful tools. Scan only systems you are authorised to test.
